name: TextInput
statusNote: TextInput has said alpha for years while GitHub ships it on nearly every form; the API is settled apart from deprecated props (variant, width, minWidth, maxWidth, icon) that still render.
summary: A single-line text field in a bordered well, with optional leading and trailing visuals, an inline trailing action, a loading spinner and a character counter. Choose Textarea for multi-line text and Select for a fixed list; wrap it in a FormControl for its label, caption and validation message.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The text. Controlled when given; otherwise defaultValue seeds an uncontrolled field.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Hint text drawn in --fgColor-muted while the field is empty. Not a label.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: The native input type; password masks, date and time types have segmented editing.

inputs.name: leadingVisual
inputs.description: An icon or short text (a currency code, a prefix) inside the field before the typing area.

inputs.name: trailingVisual
inputs.description: An icon or short text inside the field after the typing area.

inputs.name: trailingAction
inputs.description: A TextInput.Action: an invisible icon button (clear, reveal, copy) inside the field's end, with aria-label as its tooltip and name.

inputs.name: loading
inputs.description: Show a spinner in place of a visual and mark the field busy.

inputs.name: loaderPosition
inputs.description: Where the spinner goes; auto means trailing unless a leadingVisual is set, then leading.

inputs.name: loaderText
inputs.description: Visually hidden text that describes the field while loading.

inputs.name: characterLimit
inputs.description: Show an 'N characters remaining' counter under the field; exceeding it turns the field to error but does not stop typing.

inputs.name: validationStatus
inputs.description: Border colour for a validated field; error also sets aria-invalid. FormControl sets it from its Validation child.

inputs.name: contrast
inputs.description: Fill the well with --bgColor-inset instead of --bgColor-default.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Not editable, not focusable, drawn in the disabled colours.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Exposed as aria-required; FormControl also shows the label's asterisk.

inputs.name: onChange
inputs.description: Called on every edit with the new text.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: The well: a 1px --control-borderColor-rest border, medium radius, --bgColor-default fill and an inset 1px top shadow; it clips its children and lays them out in a row.

anatomy.name: Leading visual
anatomy.description: An icon or short text in --fgColor-muted, vertically centred, never shrinking.

anatomy.name: Input
anatomy.description: The editable text run: transparent, borderless, filling the remaining width, inheriting the container's font and colour.

anatomy.name: Placeholder
anatomy.description: Hint text in --fgColor-muted, drawn only while the input is empty.

anatomy.name: Trailing visual
anatomy.description: An icon or short text in --fgColor-muted after the input.

anatomy.name: Trailing action
anatomy.description: An invisible-variant IconButton sized to the field (24px at medium, 20px at small, 28px at large), --fgColor-muted turning --fgColor-default on hover or focus, with a 4px margin each side.

anatomy.name: Loading spinner
anatomy.description: A Spinner that takes a visual's place: 16px when the slot is empty, else drawn over the hidden visual at the visual's size.

anatomy.name: Character counter
anatomy.description: A line under the container in small body text: '<n> characters remaining' in --fgColor-muted, or an AlertFill icon and '<n> characters over' in --fgColor-danger, 4px apart.

variants.description: 28px minimum height, 3px block padding, small body text on a 20px line; the trailing action is 20px.
32px minimum height, no block padding, medium body text on a 20px line; the trailing action is 24px.
40px fixed height, 10px block padding, medium body text; visuals sit 12px from the edges and the trailing action is 28px.

layout.text: The container is an inline row whose children stretch to its height; it is at least 32px tall at medium (28px at small) and grows only if a child is taller; large is exactly 40px. Borders are inside the height.
Text is medium body size on a 20px line (small body size at small); the input carries no vertical padding of its own and is centred in the stretched row by the platform text field.

Block padding is 0 at medium, 3px top and bottom at small and 10px at large; the size rules' 8px inline padding is cancelled by the wrapper, so the inline insets come only from the visual rules below.

Inline insets depend on which visuals are present. With none, the input pads 12px each side. With a leading visual, the container pads 8px before it (12px at large). With a trailing visual and no action, the container pads 8px after it (12px at large). Where an end has no visual, the input itself pads 8px on that side.
Every child but the last is followed by an 8px gap; visuals and the action are vertically centred, keep their size and are coloured --fgColor-muted.

The trailing action sits 4px in from its neighbours on both sides, with 2px block and 4px inline padding inside a square button of --inner-action-size: 24px at medium, 20px at small, 28px at large. It draws Button's invisible variant otherwise.
Width hugs the input's intrinsic width unless block, which makes the container a full-width flex row.

A spinner in an empty slot is the small 16px Spinner. A spinner over a visual is absolutely positioned to the visual's box (full height, capped at its width, pinned to the inner edge for a leading slot) while the visual is hidden but keeps its space.
The character counter is a separate row after the container (outside the border), in small body text, with a 16px AlertFill icon before the message when over the limit and a 4px gap.

states.text: Rest: --bgColor-default fill, --control-borderColor-rest border, --shadow-inset, --fgColor-default text, text cursor over the whole container.

While the input has focus (pointer or keyboard, not only focus-visible), the border turns --borderColor-accent-emphasis and a 2px outline of the same colour is drawn at offset -1px, so it covers the 1px border and reaches 1px outside the box. With a trailing action present, only focus in the input itself draws the ring; focusing the action does not. There is no hover state.
Border --borderColor-danger-emphasis; when focused, border and the 2px outline turn --control-borderColor-danger. Exceeding characterLimit forces this state.

states.label: success
states.text: Border --bgColor-success-emphasis. When focused the accent outline still draws over it, since the success border rule comes later at equal specificity.
Text --fgColor-disabled, fill --control-bgColor-disabled, border --control-borderColor-disabled, no inset shadow, not-allowed cursor; not focusable.
The spinner replaces the trailing visual (auto, unless a leading visual exists, then the leading one) or sits where loaderPosition says; the field stays editable and is marked busy.

behaviour.text: A press anywhere on the container focuses the input, except a press directly on a date, time or datetime-local input, which must keep the segment the press landed on.

The character counter counts the current value's length (UTF-16 code units, as String.length does) against characterLimit: 'N character(s) remaining' at or under the limit, 'N character(s) over' above it, singular at 1. Over the limit the field takes the error state and aria-invalid, but input is not blocked.
Focus and blur of the input drive the focused state; there is no transition on the ring or border colour.
The trailing action's aria-label is also its tooltip, shown below it by default (tooltipDirection s); it is a separate tab stop after the input.

keyboard: Tab focuses the input, then the trailing action if any.
Typing edits; the platform's text-editing keys apply (arrows, Home, End, selection, clipboard, undo).
semantics: Name from the FormControl label (or aria-label); a field without one is unlabelled.
aria-required when required; aria-invalid=true only for error (including over the character limit).

aria-describedby lists, in order: the static 'You can enter up to N characters' message (with a limit), the caller's describedby (FormControl's validation and caption), the leading visual, the trailing visual and the loading text; visuals are aria-hidden but still describe the field, so a text visual such as a unit is read.
While loading the container is aria-busy and the loaderText describes the field.
With a limit, the remaining or over message is announced through a polite status region debounced 500ms after the last change, not on first show; the visible counter is aria-hidden.

notes.text: The input is a native <input>: caret, selection, IME, clipboard, undo, autofill (and the browser's autofill tint), password masking, spellcheck and the date/time segment editors are the browser's. A native build supplies every one of these, plus the --fgColor-muted placeholder that vanishes on the first character.
Horizontal scrolling of text longer than the field, and keeping the caret in view while typing, is the native input's; the container clips (overflow hidden) and draws no fade or ellipsis.

Without block or an explicit width the field's width is the browser's default for an <input> (about 20 average characters of the current font); a native build picks a default width, conventionally measured in the field's font, since nothing in the CSS gives one.
The focus ring follows :focus-within, which also fires for a pointer press, unlike buttons' :focus-visible ring. A native build draws the ring whenever the field has focus.

The focus outline straddles the edge: 2px at offset -1px lands 1px over the border and 1px outside the container. A native build must draw it outside the container's clip, or reserve 1px around the field.
Success borders read --bgColor-success-emphasis, a background token, not --borderColor-success-emphasis; they differ in light (#1f883d against #1a7f37) and in high-contrast dark.

Medium sets a minimum height, not a height; a tall child such as a 32px Spinner in an empty visual slot would grow it. Large sets a fixed 40px height, so its 10px block padding leaves 18px for content. Sizes differ in kind, not only in number.
The 3px and 10px block paddings and the 2px danger outline width are literals in the module; the accent outline reads --borderWidth-thick. --inner-action-size is a module-local variable, not a token.
--control-bgColor-contrast is read for the contrast fill but is not a Primer token (a GitHub feature flag provides it), so the fill falls back to --bgColor-inset everywhere outside github.com.

The deprecated variant='small' sets font-size: (--text-body-size-small) without var(), which is invalid and dropped, so it keeps the medium size; size='small' is correct. The deprecated variant='large' sets --text-title-size-medium, a 20px title size, unlike size='large'.

The rule commented 'ensures inputs don't zoom on mobile' sets the same 14px as the base rule under --viewportRange-regular, so it changes nothing; iOS Safari still zooms a focused input under 16px. A native build has no such zoom.

The coarse-pointer 44px target for the trailing action is written as a nested bare ::after, which resolves to descendants' ::after rather than the button's own, so it may not enlarge the button's target. Give the action a 44px-tall hit area for a coarse pointer regardless.
background-repeat and background-position (right 8px center) are leftovers for validation icons drawn as background images; nothing sets a background image now.
No size changes for a coarse pointer, except the trailing action's intended 44px hit area.
